title: A client asks a question on an estimate

steps.caption: Estimates
steps.narration: When a client has a question about an estimate, they can ask it right on the estimate.

steps.caption: The client's estimate
steps.narration: First, your client's screen. They have the estimate open.

steps.caption: Questions about this estimate?
steps.narration: Near the bottom is a box for questions. It names the salesperson who will answer.

steps.value: Can both units be done in the same week?
steps.caption: The question
Sent
steps.narration: The page says a reply will come by email, and that it is saved in their portal.

steps.caption: Back to the CRM
steps.narration: Now your screen, in the CRM.

steps.caption: Unread count
steps.narration: The number beside Messages has gone up.

steps.caption: About estimate E-2000
steps.narration: The message says which estimate it is about, above the question.

steps.value: Yes. Both units, Monday to Thursday.
steps.caption: Your answer
Send the reply
steps.narration: Then send. Your reply goes to their email, and shows in their portal.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Questions from estimates land under Messages, in the left menu.

youtube.title: When a client asks a question on an estimate | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: See both sides of a question on an estimate in the ConstructHUB CRM. The client asks from the estimate page; the question lands in your Messages inbox marked with the estimate's number, and your reply goes to their email and their portal. Recorded in a demo workspace with a made-up client.
